message:
You know that moment when you realize you’re not as ready as you thought? 😅 Last week, we had a surprise thunderstorm, and I dashed around the house looking for our go-bags. Well, let’s just say they were both in the garage, buried under a pile of beach towels and old gardening tools. It was a comical scramble, but it reminded us how important it is to keep our essentials accessible and organized. 

We learned that preparedness doesn’t have to be perfect; it just needs to be practical. How do you keep your go-bags ready or your emergency plans in check? We’d love to hear your tips!
